name: Reflecting Masjid
summary: A compact mosque meets one soft water band, suggesting a quiet reflecting courtyard.
why: The architecture stays on a strict shared baseline. The water has the same outer width as the mosque, and its central turn follows the doorway axis, creating one calm vertical composition.
risk: The water metaphor may suggest a waterside mosque; the clear architectural silhouette keeps prayer central.

palette.name: REFLECTING MASJID / PLASTER + EARTH + WARM GOLD

reasonToChoose: You want a mosque identity that also conveys stillness.
